text: Please welcome our host for today. You know his voice from Kenyan radio and television, he is an award-winning theatre-maker, and they call him The Most Bankable Host: Brian Aseli.

label: Short bio
text: Brian Aseli is a Nairobi-based host, master of ceremonies and moderator known as The Most Bankable Host. Live on national radio and television since 2017 and an award-winning theatre-maker, he brings broadcast discipline and stage timing to conferences, awards nights, launches and panel conversations.

label: Full bio
text: Brian Aseli is a Kenyan host, master of ceremonies, moderator and theatre-maker known as The Most Bankable Host. He was on air in his first year at Daystar University and has presented live on national radio and television since 2017, from youth and arts programming to daily breakfast and mid-morning radio and late-night entertainment TV. He currently co-hosts Vibe Shift and Friday Night Rave. He is also a director, scriptwriter and music director in Kenyan theatre, and won Best Musical Arrangement/Score/Adaptation at the 2024 Kenya Theatre Awards for Jaboya. On stage he has hosted the Kenya Theatre Awards ceremony and the launch of the Kenya International Theatre Festival. Brian brings the same discipline to every room (preparation, timing and a real connection with the audience) across conferences, awards nights, launches and executive conversations. He is based in Nairobi.
